summaries.text: This bill designates the outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Michigan Center, Michigan, as the Captain Herbert Elfring Department of Veterans Affairs Clinic or the Captain Herbert Elfring VA Clinic.

title: To rename the community-based outpatient clinic of the Department of Veterans Affairs in Michigan Center, Michigan, as the "Captain Herbert Elfring VA Clinic".
